author: SnowSX3
body:
It's currently 9pm NZST or 4am EST.
No staff are on the server, on TeamSpeak, on Slack, or on the forums.

Not a single staff member is on any Avicus service.
Meanwhile, two hackers fuck up the 1 active server that's online.

Tomer_Tree
Fly.

iBjoBjo
Fly.

This was going to be an online report but I made this public because something needs to be done about this.
I don't come on everyday, but everytime I do I run into a hacker and no staff are awake to do anything about it.

Fix this please.

Hello {tag=c58188cb25d84d4497b111a598917f1b},

Sorry about the current situation. Hopefully something is done about this problem soon. To help ease the problem as much as possible, I downloaded MineChat to help ban hackers when I can't reach the computer. My timezone is close to Australlia so you don't have to rely only on the Australlian staff.

Thanks for the report, banned both of them!
-PokerFace
